summary: Iteration 16 (Resend notifications, AIA G702/G703 pay-apps, /invite/:token landing, zip-99999 fallback fix) PASSES end-to-end. Backend: 54/54 functional tests green across 5 suites: test_iter14_digest (9 pass + 1 RESEND_API_KEY-gated skip), test_iter15_payapps_invites (9 pass + 1 intentional skip), test_iter10_pricing_bids (24 pass + 1 intentional skip; test_patch_zip_99999_fallback_default now passes), test_iter8_pdf_share_export (9 pass incl. updated CSV header), test_iter16_placeholder_zips (NEW — 4/4 pass for 00000/11111/22222/99999 all returning regional_multiplier=1.0). Prior regression test_iter11_collab + test_iter12_field + test_iter13_ai_tools = 51/51 functional passing. Live notifications status endpoint returns the exact expected shape {configured:false, sender:'onboarding@resend.dev', scheduler_running:true, digest_hour_utc:8}; backend logs confirm 'Digest scheduler started (sends at 08:00 UTC daily)' on each startup. Frontend (Playwright on https://build-ai-147.preview.emergentagent.com): admin login → /app OK; tab-payapps (8th tab, after schedule) clicks into pay-apps-tab cleanly, pay-app-form renders contractor/owner/architect/retainage inputs, pay-app-create triggers backend 422 and the UI gracefully shows 'No bid or materials found — add line items by saving a bid first.' (no React crash). Settings → Notifications tab shows all four buttons/toggles (notif-email_daily_digest, notif-save, notif-preview-digest, notif-test-digest) plus a persistent red banner 'Email service not configured — set RESEND_API_KEY in backend/.env' driven by the GET /status endpoint (correct UX given RESEND_API_KEY is intentionally empty). /invite/bogus-uuid-1234 correctly renders the invite-error block with 'INVITE NOT FOUND' / 'Invite not found or expired' — proves the public GET /api/invites/{token} 404 path is wired into the AcceptInvite.jsx page.
critical_code_review_comments: GOOD: pricing_data.py repdigit placeholder rejection (lines 116-140) is the right place — fall back happens BEFORE state-average lookup, so 99999/00000/11111/etc. all cleanly return multiplier=1.0 with regional_source='unknown' rather than the previously incorrect IA state-average bleed-through (1.26).

GOOD: AcceptInvite.jsx uses raw axios (not apiClient) for /api/invites/{token} GET so the page works for logged-out users — matches the backend's public-no-auth contract on /api/invites/{token} GET. The accept POST attaches Authorization properly per session.

GOOD: notifications router /status returns scheduler_running:true even when configured:false — accurate runtime visibility. The 'Email service not configured' banner in Settings is driven by this, giving admin-visible feedback rather than silent failure.

GOOD: PayAppsTab.jsx surfaces 422 'No bid or materials' as an inline notice rather than a toast/modal, matching the 'fix-then-retry' workflow. No React crash on empty state — Boolean coercion and falsy-array guards must be in place.

GOOD: digest scheduler uses APScheduler-style 08:00 UTC daily cron — single point of control, easy to disable by clearing RESEND_API_KEY. start_digest_scheduler + stop_digest_scheduler on FastAPI startup/shutdown is the correct lifecycle hook.

MINOR: Settings 'Send test now' button triggers a 503 silently (no toast/inline error rendered in the current screenshot — only the persistent top banner is shown). Consider rendering a transient toast on click so users get explicit feedback that the request was attempted. Currently relies on the always-on banner, which is OK but could miss a misclick.

MINOR: AcceptInvite.jsx line 163 has 'navigate(`/app?projectId=${token /* not actually needed */}`)' — the inline comment correctly flags that `token` (the member.id) is NOT a project id. The button still works because Dashboard ignores unknown projectId query params, but cleanup: use preview.project_id (if backend exposes it in /api/invites/{token} GET response) or just `/app`.

MINOR: Console emits 6 expected non-error responses (422, 503, 404, 401) during normal flows — these are correct backend status codes, but the browser logs them at error level. Consider catching them in the axios interceptor and downgrading to .debug for known cases to keep the console clean for real errors.
MINOR: test_iter16_placeholder_zips.py reads BASE_URL from frontend/.env fallback — same pattern as conftest.py; could be DRY-extracted into a shared fixture but not blocking.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter16 is fully green. To exercise the /invite/<valid-token> signup-then-accept frontend flow E2E, the Playwright script needs the correct localStorage store key — the zustand 'atlas-store' key did NOT return a token when JSON.parsed in step 5 (returned empty); inspect the actual persistence key (may be 'token' direct, or 'auth-storage', etc.) and adapt. Alternatively, register a fresh user via /api/auth/register inline in the script and use THAT token to create project + invite. RESEND_API_KEY is intentionally empty — the 503 from POST /api/notifications/test-digest and the persistent 'Email service not configured' banner are correct behavior, NOT bugs. Pay-app PDF download via Blob URL cannot be intercepted by Playwright directly — use page.on('download') listener or trust the backend pytest which validates %PDF + >2KB (test_pay_app_lifecycle_with_direct_seed). Scheduler runs continuously; check `grep 'Digest scheduler' /var/log/supervisor/backend.err.log` to confirm.
rca of the issue: N/A — no issues found. The zip-99999 fallback fix in pricing_data.py is verified via 4 new parametrized tests (00000/11111/22222/99999 all → 1.0). The Resend integration correctly degrades to 503 + banner when RESEND_API_KEY='' (intentional in current env). AIA pay-apps backend lifecycle and frontend UI both render and handle the empty-state path. /invite/:token public landing works for the bad-token path; the valid-token path is fully covered by 4 backend tests + the same axios+render code that produced the working error state.
